provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Ross, Chapter 27 Zoning, as published on eCode360, with the Table of Use Regulations (27 Attachment 1) and the Residential Use Dimensional Regulations Table (27 Attachment 2)
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code RO2521): includes legislation through 04-20-2026. The use table carries Ord. No. 2564 of 3/16/2026. New Laws (4): Ord. 2568 to 2571 (Ch 1, 13, 15). None amends Chapter 27. Read in the eCode360 print view and the attachment PDFs in a browser. Currency gap: the code runs through 04-20-2026 and New Laws starts at Ord. No. 2568 (2026-09-21). Ordinances 2565 to 2567, if any, were not seen.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360: Includes legislation through 04-20-2026. New Laws (4), none for Chapter 27.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit or accessory apartment rule. The Table of Use Regulations has no ADU row. Land may be used only for uses permitted in 27-906 (27-901.1)

Uses similar to those in the Table of Use Regulations may be permitted by conditional use (27-904), judged against 'any use specifically listed in the zoning district'. A second unit is a two-family dwelling or a conversion, both listed. In R-1 and R-5 both are N, 'not permitted' (27-902.4). Reading: 27-904 does not reach a second unit. The path is a use variance
R-1 allows 'Only one primary or main building' per lot (27-901.2)

The accessory building definition includes 'guest houses, and domestic servant or caretaker living quarters for those employed on the premises'. Residential accessory structures are permitted in all residential districts (27-202, Table of Use Regulations)

Residential accessory buildings: at most two per lot, 720 sq ft combined, 14 ft high to the peak. 5 ft from side lines, 15 ft from the rear line (100 to 720 sq ft). Not in the required front yard (27-906.6.D)
Two-family dwellings are permitted in R-2, R-3 and R-4. Duplex lot area 5,000 sq ft per dwelling unit, 100 ft wide for two units (Table of Use Regulations, 27 Attachment 2)

Conversion of an existing single-family detached dwelling into two or more apartments is a conditional use in R-2 and permitted in R-3 and R-4. 2,000 sq ft of lot per dwelling unit. 1.5 parking spaces per unit (27-202, 27-906.1.E)
Parking for a single-family detached dwelling: two spaces per dwelling unit, one in a garage (27-906.1.A)
Owners of rental property report the names of their tenants to the Earned Income Tax Collector within 15 days of occupancy (11-101)
A single-family dwelling may be built on a lawful lot of record below the district minimum (27-1003.1). Nothing allows a second unit on such a lot
Lot area is stated per dwelling unit (SF/DU): R-1 10,000, R-2 and R-3 6,500 for single-family. Density R-1 4 per acre, R-2 and R-3 6 per acre (27 Attachment 2)

Pending: none on the New Laws list. Review fixes 2026-11-11: term null, path variance, 27-904 not used as a path, lot area per unit, 27-1003.

term.note: No ADU term. Searched for accessory dwelling, accessory apartment, in-law, granny, elder, ECHO, carriage, second dwelling. The accessory building definition names 'domestic servant or caretaker living quarters for those employed on the premises'. It is recorded as an alternative.

status.note: The code has no ADU text. No ADU row in the use table.

path.note: No use except 'for the purposes permitted in § 27-906'. A second unit is a two-family dwelling or conversion. In R-1 and R-5 both are N. A use variance is the path. In R-2 to R-4 the two-family and conversion alternatives apply. 27-904 (similar uses) is at most a question to ask.

value.name: Domestic servant or caretaker living quarters (accessory building)
value.conditions: Only for those employed on the premises. Residential accessory building rules: 720 sq ft combined, 14 ft high, 5 ft side, 15 ft rear. In R-4 and R-5 single-family detached is N, so only beside an existing house.

value.name: Two-family dwelling (duplex)
value.conditions: Duplex lot area 5,000 sq ft per dwelling unit, 100 ft wide for two units. Front 25, side 10, rear 30 ft. Two spaces per unit, one in a garage.

value.name: Conversion of a single-family house into apartments
value.conditions: Existing single-family detached dwelling. 2,000 sq ft of lot per unit. Exterior changes need Board of Commissioners approval. Stairs not on the front wall. 1.5 spaces per unit.

value.name: Conversion of a single-family house into apartments
value.conditions: Existing single-family detached dwelling. 2,000 sq ft of lot per unit. Exterior changes need Board of Commissioners approval. 1.5 spaces per unit.

alternatives.note: Use table rows 'Two-Family' N P P P N and 'Conversion' N C P P N for R-1 to R-5.

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. Reading of a silent code.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path.

value.condition: R-1: 'Only one primary or main building may be erected on a single lot'. Reading: a detached unit is possible only as an accessory building, not as a second house.
The accessory living quarters named in the code are for domestic servants or caretakers 'employed on the premises', or guest houses.
Residential accessory buildings: at most two per lot, 720 sq ft combined, 14 ft to the peak, not in the required front yard.
Owners of rental property report their tenants to the Earned Income Tax Collector within 15 days of occupancy.

gates.note: Rules that reach any second unit.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory rule, not an ADU rule: 'the height of each shall not exceed 14 feet as measured from the finished floor level to the peak'.

accessory_structure_max_sqft.note: 'No more than two residential accessory buildings with a combined square footage of 720 square feet'.

setback_front_ft.note: No number. Not in the required front yard.

setback_side_ft.note: 'shall not be located closer than five feet to any side property line'.

setback_rear_ft.note: 15 ft for buildings of 100 to 720 sq ft. 5 ft under 100 sq ft.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: Detached accessory buildings 'may occupy a required side yard' and a required rear yard.

internal_uses_district_height.note: A unit inside or attached to the house takes the 2-story, 35 ft district height.

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A family may include 'domestic servants or gratuitous guests' with 'single cooking facilities'.

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code lists no ADU.

reading.value: Single-family detached: two spaces per dwelling unit, at least one in a garage. If the second unit counts as a dwelling unit, four in total. A conversion needs 1.5 per unit.

min_lot_sqft.note: 10,000 sq ft per dwelling unit, 75 ft wide, 4 units per acre.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Single-family 'Minimum Lot Area (SF/DU)' 10,000. Density 4 dwelling units per acre. Open whether a second unit counts as a dwelling unit.

min_lot_sqft.note: 6,500 sq ft, 60 ft wide. Duplex 5,000 sq ft per dwelling unit.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Single-family 'Minimum Lot Area (SF/DU)' 6,500. Density 6 dwelling units per acre. Open whether a second unit counts as a dwelling unit.

min_lot_sqft.note: 6,500 sq ft, 60 ft wide. Duplex 5,000 sq ft per dwelling unit.

lot_area_per_unit_sqft.note: Single-family 'Minimum Lot Area (SF/DU)' 6,500. Density 6 dwelling units per acre. Open whether a second unit counts as a dwelling unit.
